Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

dicomtk.fl 0.1.0

Initial Release

  • Trusted Third-Party (TTP) & Polymorphic Encryption/Pseudonymisation (PEP): Added ttp_mainzelliste_client (Mainzelliste REST + deterministic offline mode), pep_derive_site_token(), and pep_rekey_pseudonym() for cryptographically unlinkable cross-project/cross-site pseudonyms.
  • Privacy-Preserving Record Linkage (PPRL): Added pprl_encode_bloom(), pprl_dice_similarity(), and pprl_link_cohorts() with keyed HMAC-SHA256 q-gram double-hashing, randomized response bit-flipping, and constant-weight balanced Bloom filter padding.
  • Differential Privacy (DP) Federated Analytics: Added dp_budget_accountant, dp_suppress_small_cells(), dp_laplace_mechanism(), dp_gaussian_mechanism(), dp_federated_summary(), and dp_aggregate_sites() with explicit sensitivity clipping and minimum-cell kk-anonymity enforcement.
  • Federated Learning Exporters & Governance Gate: Added fl_site_approval_gate (site_admin-only HMAC-SHA256 manifest signing and revocation) and fl_export_site_package() for Flower, NVIDIA FLARE, and OpenFL site bundles.
